tasks_completed.description: Add images.json read to hydrate_trip() with FileNotFoundError fallback
tasks_completed.changes: Added json import; added images_path read with try/except FileNotFoundError; normalized to {pois, city_covers} only stripping destination/fallback_unsplash; added 'images' key to return dict
tasks_completed.rationale: API was returning {meta, days, transportation, route_cache} only — images.json was never read. Feature needs the data exposed at GET /api/trip/<id>.

tasks_completed.description: Add state.images to state object and wire _fetchTrip() assignment
tasks_completed.changes: Added images: {} to state export; added state.images = { pois: data.images?.pois || {}, city_covers: data.images?.city_covers || {} } after route_cache assignment in _fetchTrip()
tasks_completed.rationale: Frontend had no storage for image lookup data; assignment uses optional chaining with empty fallbacks to handle API transition period.

tasks_completed.changes: Added as first child of article in #tpl-candidate-card, before .card-head
tasks_completed.rationale: Template had no img element; clones from _buildCard() and _buildMealsCandidateGroup() therefore had no photo slot.

tasks_completed.description: Add #trip-cover img as first child of #tab-timeline
tasks_completed.changes: Added as first child of #tab-timeline div, before .timeline-header
tasks_completed.rationale: No cover image element existed in the document. Placed inside #tab-timeline (not header) to avoid grid disruption.

tasks_completed.description: Add _writeCardPhoto() helper and wire into _buildCard() and _buildMealsCandidateGroup()
tasks_completed.changes: Added _writeCardPhoto(node, opt) function with name_local guard, gaode_ prefix lookup, onerror handler, and removeAttribute('src') for no-match case. Called from _buildCard() and _buildMealsCandidateGroup() after cloning the template.
tasks_completed.rationale: Both card-building code paths needed the same image lookup logic. Extracted into a shared helper.

tasks_completed.description: Add img.card-photo to _writeSlotSelected() for timeline selected cards
tasks_completed.changes: Added img element creation with className='card-photo', draggable=false, onerror handler, gaode_ lookup, and hidden fallback. Img appended before nameDiv using appendChild (img first, then nameDiv).
tasks_completed.rationale: Timeline selected cards had no photo element. Fixed a bug during implementation: initially used insertBefore before nameDiv was appended — corrected to appendChild sequence.

tasks_completed.description: Add renderCover() and wire into renderAll()
tasks_completed.changes: Added renderCover() function with null-day guard, _deriveCityName() call, city_covers lookup, onerror handler, and img.hidden/removeAttribute('src') for no-match. Called from renderAll() after renderTimeline().
tasks_completed.rationale: Cover image must update on day switch; wiring to renderAll() ensures it re-runs whenever the active day changes.

tasks_completed.changes: Added .card-photo (width 100%, aspect-ratio 16/9, object-fit cover, border-radius 4px, display block), #trip-cover (width 100%, aspect-ratio 21/9, object-fit cover, display block, margin-bottom 24px), and .card-photo[hidden] / #trip-cover[hidden] { display: none } rules. No token changes, no grid changes.
tasks_completed.rationale: Photo elements need sizing and object-fit rules. Hidden selector is component-scoped (not bare img[hidden]) as required.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — missing feature, not regression. Editor built in commits 7b416587/8b7d4e0c/dbb35f72 without photo rendering.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Photos were implemented in the static HTML generator (render_html_builders.py) but never ported to the interactive editor (state.js + trip.py) when Cycle 3 built the 3-column Notion layout.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Exposes images.json data via the API (trip.py), stores it in client state (_fetchTrip), adds img elements to templates (index.html), and wires lookup logic into all three card-building code paths (_buildCard, _buildMealsCandidateGroup, _writeSlotSelected) plus a new renderCover() function.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: 86 lines for 4 files covering server + state + template + CSS; the 16-line overage above minimum is the onerror handlers (2x), null guards (2x), and CSS hidden selectors — all required by the spec's S1 and M11 requirements.
